// diagnostic E2412

Jet.UnknownDecodedField

`Jet.UnknownDecodedField: unknown field `{field}`` (runtime `FieldError`).

What

`Jet.UnknownDecodedField: unknown field `{field}`` (runtime `FieldError`).

Why

The struct is marked `#Codable(unknown: .Deny)` and the input carried a key the struct doesn't declare, so decoding fails instead of silently dropping it.

Fix

Remove `#Codable(unknown: .Deny)` to ignore extra keys (the lenient default), add the field, or fix the producer.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnknownDecodedField: Tests/UI/json_decode_unknown_field_refused.stderr.

Error: Jet.UnknownDecodedField: unknown field `extra`
